updates.note: Management states watches margin will target mid-teen band, 15% to 16% in 1-2 year timeframe.
updates.quote: mid-teen is a good number to aim for, 15% to 16% for the business, at least in the 1-year, 2-year time frame.

updates.note: Management reiterates intent to keep margins within the range-bound guidance despite gold price headwinds.
updates.quote: we are trying to deliver consistent, stable range, but it could be slightly pluses and minuses, not significant variations we are expecting.

new_promises.statement: Open 35 to 40 new Tanishq stores in FY26.
new_promises.quote: purely from new stores on Tanishq, I think 35 to 40 is a reasonable range to expect. 40 is the target.
new_promises.speaker: Ajoy Chawla

new_promises.statement: Expand and renovate 70 to 80 stores for the year.
new_promises.quote: overall, for the renovations, etcetera, 70 to 80 may be the orders that may happen for the year.
new_promises.speaker: Ajoy Chawla

new_promises.statement: Achieve 13% to 14% growth in the eyewear business for FY26.
new_promises.quote: we believe that we should be closing this year at a slightly higher number than what you are seeing, anywhere between 13% to 14%.
new_promises.speaker: N. S. Raghavan
